jobs.description:
Cisco Security Consultant, Stockholm - Hybrid
The position is a permanent employment opportunity with our client.
Background:
This employer is a long-term partner of Cisco and Palo Alto. They are now hiring consultants to cover the customer demand of support with their Cyber Security portfolio.

The Company is a re-seller of IT, networking, SaaS, and cybersecurity solutions. On top of this offering, they also offer expertise in the form of project-based consultants that are experts in their field. They are now looking for Security consultants that can act as experts that help implement, run, and fine-tune the installations out in customer environments.

Experience:
- University degree (preferred but not mandatory)
- 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity within Cisco (CCNP Security, CCIE security are examples of relevant certifications)
- Experience working with Palo Alto Networks is advantageous, but main criteria is still Cisco
- Fluent/Native in Swedish mandatory
- Fluent English
- Personality type that likes to work with other people and don't mind sitting in the customer's environment
- Drive and proactiveness in their work
- Ability to work without supervision

Examples of work assignments:
- Be an expert in anything related to cybersecurity and Cisco security
- Act as an advisor and expert within the field of architecture and design of Cisco Security solutions
- Administrate workshops and presentations together with customers
- Installation, configuration and development of IT security environments
- Experience in designing and architecting Cisco and Palo Alto environments
- Experience in infrastructure security (firewalls etc.)
- Experience in SASE/SSE, ZTNA, NAC, Zero Trust
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
You will be employed directly by the company. You will receive information about which company the advertisement refers to when you are in contact with the recruiter. Bumbli Group is therefore not the employer but the recruitment agency.
Welcome to submit your application!
Bumbli Group is part of House of Recruitment — a personal, traditional and quality-driven recruitment agency in Gothenburg.

Mission Brief 
 
The Test Operations Engineer is part of a multidisciplinary team responsible for the development and verification testing of liquid rocket engines and their subsystems. The role focuses on the planning, execution, and evaluation of propulsion tests, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable test operations while coordinating closely with design, maintenance, and operations teams.
Your Role in Our Space Mission: 
Plan and coordinate propulsion test campaigns, supporting development, verification, and qualification activities.
Develop, review, and execute test procedures, operational documentation, and risk assessments.
Operate and monitor tests from the control room, ensuring safe execution and responding to off-nominal conditions.
Analyze test and facility data to verify test objectives, investigate anomalies, and support root cause analysis.
Develop and continuously improve test operations procedures, work instructions, and processes.
Collaborate with design, maintenance, and facility engineering teams to prepare, commission, operate, and improve test facilities and ground support equipment.
Support system commissioning, operational readiness reviews, and the introduction of new test capabilities.

 
Qualification Checklist 
Relevant technical qualification, bachelor's or master's degree in aerospace, mechanical, chemical, industrial engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on experience operating, maintaining, testing, or developing complex mechanical or fluid systems.
Experience with process systems involving gases, liquids, pressure systems, pumps, valves, instrumentation, or similar industrial equipment.
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically and implement practical corrective actions.
Understanding of engineering fundamentals and the ability to support design, modification, and commissioning activities.
Comfortable working in fast-paced test environments and maintaining focus during critical operations.
Physical dexterity is required, as the role may involve working in confined spaces and on industrial equipment.
Able to lift and carry up to 25 kg.
Fluent in English.

 
Bonus Skills 
Experience with high-pressure, cryogenic, hazardous, flammable, or other demanding process systems.
Hands-on experience with fluid systems, piping, tubing, valves, regulators, and instrumentation.
Experience planning and performing maintenance on industrial or test equipment.
Experience commissioning new equipment, facilities, or process systems.
Familiarity with data analysis and interpretation of test or operational data.
Experience with at least one programming or scripting language (Python, MATLAB, C#, etc.).

As an AIT (Assembly, Integration & Test) Technician at our rocket engine test site in Kiruna, you will be responsible for the preparation, assembly, integration, checkout, and troubleshooting of rocket engines, test articles, and associated hardware. Working closely with engineers and test operators, you will ensure test articles are ready for safe and successful test execution while supporting commissioning and test campaigns. 
Your Role in Our Space Mission: 
Perform assembly, integration, disassembly, and inspections of rocket engines, test articles, and associated mechanical systems.
Prepare and configure test articles for testing, including instrumentation installation, checkouts, and pre-test verification activities.
Support commissioning, pressure testing, and hotfire campaigns through execution of operational procedures and test preparations.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to test articles, engine hardware, and mechanical interfaces.
Conduct maintenance, repairs, and modifications of test articles and associated support equipment.
Assist in the installation, removal, and transportation of engines and test hardware within the test facility.
Maintain accurate records of assembly, inspections, non-conformances, maintenance activities, and test preparations.
Ensure compliance with operational procedures and safety requirements during all activities.
Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, tooling, and test article handling methods.
Support facility maintenance and infrastructure activities when required by operational priorities. 

Qualification Checklist 
At least 3 years of experience in a hands-on mechanical, assembly, or integration role.
Experience assembling and troubleshooting complex mechanical systems.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, procedures, and assembly instructions.
Experience using precision measurement tools, hand tools, and workshop equipment.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Safety-conscious mindset and ability to work in hazardous environments.
Effective communication skills and ability to work within a multidisciplinary team.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written. 

Bonus Skills
Experience with rocket propulsion systems, aerospace hardware, or development testing.
Experience with instrumentation installation and checkout activities.
Familiarity with pressure systems, leak testing, and cryogenic operations.
Crane, forklift, or rigging certifications.
Relevant technical education or vocational training

Mission Brief 
As a Maintenance Technician at our rocket engine test site in Kiruna, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and reliability of the test facility infrastructure. This includes fluid systems, piping networks, valves, ground support equipment, and mechanical facility systems that enable safe and efficient propulsion testing. 
Your Role in Our Space Mission: 
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on facility systems, including piping, valves, pressure systems, mechanical equipment, and ground support infrastructure.
Troubleshoot mechanical and fluid system issues to maximize facility availability and test readiness.
Install, modify, and commission facility systems and test support equipment required for test campaigns.
Execute rigging, lifting, and installation activities associated with facility upgrades and test preparations.
Support pressure testing, leak checks, commissioning, and operational readiness activities.
Assist engineers with facility modifications, improvements, and infrastructure upgrades.
Maintain maintenance records, inspection reports, calibration documentation, and work instructions.
Ensure compliance with operational procedures, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.
Proactively propose improvements to increase facility reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
Support test article integration and AIT activities when required by operational priorities. 

Qualification Checklist 
At least 3 years of experience in industrial maintenance, mechanical systems, process facilities, or similar environments.
Strong experience with piping systems, valves, pumps, pressure systems, and mechanical equipment.
Experience performing troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs on industrial infrastructure.
Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, technical drawings, schematics, and maintenance procedures.
Experience with rigging, lifting operations, and mechanical installations.
Strong mechanical aptitude and proficiency with tools, measurement instruments, and maintenance equipment.
Safety-conscious mindset and ability to work in hazardous environments.
Effective communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with engineers and technicians.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written

Bonus Skills
Experience with cryogenic, high-pressure gas, or propulsion test facilities.
Welding, pipefitting, hydraulic, or pneumatic system experience.
Crane, forklift, or rigging certifications.
Experience in a development test environment.
Relevant technical education, certifications, or trade qualifications.

CERN is preparing the Future Circular Collider (FCC) project for potential approval by the CERN Council in 2028/29. The importance and the size of the FCC project require a communication campaign from a local to an international scale, engaging CERN's neighbouring population, the wider public, the broader scientific community, and decision makers. CERN is therefore seeking an experienced senior professional to lead the FCC communication campaign, implement a communication and engagement strategy, and coordinate the creation of content and its delivery to the various stakeholders.

The role will comprise strategic thinking, strong leadership as well as excellent delivery skills.

Your responsibilities
Be responsible for implementing a comprehensive communication and engagement strategy.
Lead campaign planning and execution, manage messaging across channels, and ensure clear, consistent, and impactful communications for diverse audiences.
Coordinate content and product development, working closely with the FCC Project Office and technical teams and, interfaces with external stakeholders, as well as with writers, multimedia producers and the media and digital team.
Develop key messages, narratives and content for internal and external audiences.
Manage relationships with senior project leaders and diverse stakeholders.
Anticipate and manage reputational risks and issues.
Support local and public events related to the FCC project.
Monitor, evaluate, and report on campaign performance.
Manage potential contracts with external companies, lead and support communication staff and consultants as required.

Your profile
Proven senior-level leadership experience in large-scale communications or public engagement campaigns.
Experience working in complex, high-profile projects or multi-stakeholder and scientific environments.
Demonstrated experience in managing projects effectively and delivering results under pressure.
Experience across digital, media, and stakeholder communications.
Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Communication or Marketing or a related field.

Your skills
Strategic communications planning, including the implementation of a vision.
Project management.
Science communications.
Stakeholder relationship management and community engagement.
Participatory processes and community dialogue techniques.
Excellent spoken and written English with a good working knowledge of French.

About the Role
We are seeking an SRE / DevOps Engineer to join an agile team developing and operating business-critical connected vehicle services. You will bridge development and operations to maximize uptime, automate workflows, and maintain robust monitoring for millions of connected vehicles worldwide.
What You Will Do
Observability: Maintain and optimize monitoring, logging, and alerting (Datadog, CloudWatch, Kibana) for rapid troubleshooting and high availability.

Automation & IaC: Streamline operations and deployments using scripting (Python/Bash) and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform).

Operations: Run and support enterprise Linux environments and core AWS infrastructure; participate in the team's on-call rotation.

Collaboration & Security: Partner with engineers and product owners in a "you build it, you run it" culture while applying cloud security best practices (IAM, encryption).

Qualifications & Experience
Core Requirements:

AWS & Cloud Infrastructure: Solid hands-on experience designing and operating solutions in AWS, including Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation).

Automation & Scripting: Strong skills in operational automation using languages such as Python, Bash, or Java.

Observability & Reliability: Proven experience setting up distributed metrics, logging, and alerts (e.g. Datadog, CloudWatch, or Kibana).

Linux & Operations: Confident working in enterprise Linux environments with a solid grasp of basic networking (TCP/IP).

Ways of Working: Good understanding of modern DevOps culture, incident management, and agile delivery.

Communication: Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Meriting:

Experience with Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) or message brokers (MQTT, Kafka).

Familiarity with container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) or backend development in Java.

Prior experience from the automotive, telematics, or IoT domain.

Who You Are
An analytical problem solver focused on automation, root-cause resolution, and continuous improvement.

A communicative team player who takes ownership of production systems and bridges technical depth with business needs.

We are looking for consultants who are passionate about modern cloud technology, eager to tackle challenging client assignments, and drive technical excellence. Join us to work alongside leading technology companies and explore cutting-edge solutions in a supportive and innovative network.
We look forward to hearing from you!

ABOUT COGNIZANT
Cognizant is a leading global technology and professional services company that drives digital transformation for enterprises worldwide. We combine deep industry expertise, advanced technology capabilities, and human-centered design to solve complex business challenges. We're proud to partner with Google on mission-critical projects like Google Maps, where accuracy and attention to detail directly impact millions of users globally.

THE ROLE
Are you detail-oriented with a passion for geographic accuracy? Join our team as a Locality Expert, where you'll verify and validate Maps Data to ensure it reflects real-world changes. You'll audit critical geographic attributes—locations, names, platforms, entrances, exits, and transit positions across different transportation modes—by comparing them against trustworthy sources via web research. Your work ensures millions of users have accurate, real-time geographic information.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Audit Maps Data against real-world conditions and trustworthy sources to verify accuracy. You'll evaluate and update critical geographic attributes, work independently while managing your performance metrics, and meet defined SLA/TAT timelines. You'll also identify opportunities for improvement and communicate insights to your team lead, contributing to continuous quality enhancement.

WHO YOU ARE
Experience / Skills
● 3+ years of experience in the automotive industry or Urban planning, Traffics/ Transit/ Signals/ Signages
● Strong understanding of market research methodologies and techniques.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Local language and in English
● Native / Bilingual (B2+) in Swedish language
● Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
● Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
● Excellent time management and organizational skills.
● Strong analytical, excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
Nice-to-have skills include experience with vector data analysis, basic GIS map component knowledge, and PL/SQL basics.

WHY JOIN US?
Make global impact every day—your work directly influences how millions of people navigate the world. You'll develop specialized expertise in geospatial data quality within a team dedicated to excellence. Join Cognizant and grow with a global technology leader offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Become a specialist in a rapidly growing field of data quality assurance.

We are now looking for a highly skilled and experienced Operations Specialist to join our client’s international team and contribute to smooth and efficient operations.

jobs.occupation: Specialist Doctors in Internal Medicine Wanted for Mora Hospital, Sweden
jobs.description:
Medicinkliniken Mora is looking for experienced specialist doctors who wish to work in a broad and clinically stimulating internal medicine environment while enjoying the exceptional quality of life that Dalarna has to offer.

Mora Hospital serves a large geographical area and offers a varied patient population. As part of the Department of Internal Medicine, you will work closely with colleagues from multiple specialties while contributing to both inpatient and outpatient care.

This position is particularly suitable for specialists who appreciate broad clinical work, close collaboration and opportunities to influence and develop healthcare services.

Why Mora?
Mora is located in the heart of Dalarna and is surrounded by forests, lakes and mountains. The area is well known for outdoor activities, a strong sense of community and a healthy work-life balance.
Mora Hospital combines the advantages of a smaller hospital environment with access to modern healthcare and specialist expertise.
We Are Looking For
We are currently recruiting specialists within:
.Internal Medicine
.Nephrology
.Endocrinology / Diabetology
.Gastroenterology
.Hematology

Applicants with a background in general internal medicine and an interest in one or more of these subspecialties are also encouraged to apply.

jobs.occupation: SAP Digital Manufacturing Solution Consultant – Principal - Skövde
jobs.description:

Your primary focus will be SAP Digital Manufacturing (SAP DM), where you will translate business requirements into reliable solutions through hands-on configuration and collaboration with development teams.
Our client is transitioning towards a more agile, product-oriented way of working, with a focus on improving delivery speed, quality, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with manufacturing sites and stakeholders to understand business requirements.
Design and configure Production Process Designs (PPDs) and Production Operator Dashboards (PODs) in SAP DM.
Support implementations, global rollouts, system upgrades, and quarterly SAP DM releases.
Provide technical support and expertise to manufacturing sites.
Maintain and continuously improve manufacturing IT applications.
Collaborate with development teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Participate in the on-call rotation for production-critical systems.

Required Qualifications
Hands-on experience implementing and configuring SAP Digital Manufacturing (SAP DM).
Experience with SAP integrations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and spoken English.
A structured, quality-focused approach and strong communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.

Meritorious experience:
Background in the automotive industry.
Experience with manufacturing IT and production environments.
Experience working in agile teams or product-oriented organizations.

Who Are You?
You are an analytical and proactive professional who takes ownership and enjoys turning complex business needs into practical technical solutions. You value teamwork, open communication, and continuous improvement, and you are committed to delivering reliable, high-quality solutions.
Apply Today
Join Integro Consulting and contribute to an exciting consulting assignment with our client, helping shape the future of digital manufacturing.

Are you an experienced C++ Developer with a passion for telecom software development and real-time systems? Do you thrive in a highly technical, collaborative, and innovative environment, working on the core of 5G Baseband and RAN?

This role offers the chance to work with cutting-edge technology in 5G Baseband, and network protocols.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, test, and optimize telecom software for 5G Baseband and RAN systems.
Work with real-time programming, low-latency processing, and performance optimization.
Debug and troubleshoot complex telecom software using GDB, Wireshark, and log analysis tools.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.
Read, analyze, and implement 3GPP specifications and coding standards.

Key Competences:
BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field.
4+ years of experience in telecom software development.
Experience with real-time systems, Baseband, and RAN software development.
Knowledge and experience in 5G or 4G wireless communication.
Strong programming skills in C/C++ (required) and experience with Linux, multithreading, and low-latency systems.
Familiarity with telecom protocols MAC (scheduler) & L1 standards
AI-assisted software development, testing, debugging, and code generation would be a plus
Ability to read, analyze, and implement technical documentation and coding standards.

For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Highly experienced nanny job in Madrid, Spain
jobs.description:
Nanny with Nordic language – Madrid, Spain
Nanny position · €5,000–6,000 gross/month · Accommodation and flights included
A warm, international family in Madrid with Scandinavian roots is looking for a caring, experienced nanny to join their childcare team. This is a long-term role for someone who wants to bring a bit of the Nordic into the lives of two children.
About the family
Your task is to support the routines and education of 2 children: 5 and 7 years old.
The role
The schedule is 13:00-22:00 5-6 days a week

The family’s needs can change, so being flexible is essential.
What you’ll do
Give attentive, nurturing care to the children.
Support their daily routines, activities and play.
Help with homework and learning activities.
Encourage their development and share your knowledge of Nordic culture, traditions and everyday ways of doing things.
Work closely with their governess and household staff.

Essential:
Strong first-hand knowledge of Nordic culture and everyday life, for example from having lived in Sweden, Denmark or Norway, so you can share its traditions, routines and values with the children
Fluent spoken English
Proven childcare experience, ideally with children from infancy up to 7
Patient, kind, soft, reliable and flexible, with a positive, team-minded attitude
Interest in a long-term position

A teaching or education background

How to apply
Send your CV, a short introduction about yourself and your childcare experience, and references to info@stockholm-nanny.se, with “Nanny – Madrid” in the subject line.
Stockholm’s International Nanny Agency

jobs.description:
Job Description: Communications and Social Media Intern / Intern
Role Title: Communications and Social Media Intern at Hex the Patriarchy
Hours: Part-time or Full-time
Location: Remote from Sweden
Start Date: ASAP or sometime before January
Position Type: Internship ( Internship/ “praktik” via the Swedish Employment Agency ) Please note that this is an internship through the Swedish Employment Agency, you will not be paid by our company. 
Company Name: Honeydew Productions AB (this is our official name but our brand name is Mugwort Studios)
Company Organization Number: 559588-8727
